description.la: Epistolae Anselmi archiepiscopi Cantuariensis, libri tertius et quartus, ex Patrologia Latina 159 (1853), secundum Gerberonem. Textus ex imagine paginarum per OCR prima vice descriptus, mendis plenus.
description.en-US: The letters of Anselm as archbishop of Canterbury, Books III and IV of the Gerberon–Migne order (Patrologia Latina 159, 1853), the letters to and from kings, popes and bishops in the investiture dispute. Latin only, from a fresh OCR of the page scan: no clean transcription exists, so the text still carries many recognition errors, running heads and fragments of the printed apparatus. It is a draft to be corrected against the Migne scan; the first two books are the separate book Letters (Books I-II).
description.pt-BR: As cartas de Anselmo como arcebispo de Cantuária, livros III e IV da ordem de Gerberon e Migne (PL 159): cartas a reis, papas e bispos na questão das investiduras. Texto em rascunho, obtido por OCR de uma digitalização, ainda com muitos erros de reconhecimento.

sources.edition: S. Anselmi Cantuariensis archiepiscopi opera omnia, ed. J.-P. Migne, Patrologia Latina 159 (Paris 1853), Epistolae, libri III-IV; page scan from Documenta Catholica Omnia, re-read with Tesseract 5 (Latin model, tessdata_best) at 200 dpi.
sources.description: Letters numbered in sequence within each book (the printed numerals are not always legible); addressee lines, running heads and the printed apparatus are only partly removed, and common recognition slips (ae read as z, and so on) are corrected against the vocabulary of the other imported Latin. Expect errors.
sources.tierEvidence: Anselm died in 1109; Migne’s 1853 printing is public domain everywhere.
